title: Classroom Rules & 'wh'

activities.title: Our Classroom Rules
keys: May I go to the bathroom?

scenes.t: In {name}'s class, everyone follows the classroom rules.
If you want to answer, raise your hand.
When the teacher talks, listen carefully.
When class starts, sit down. Don't run in class!
Be kind to your classmates, and keep your classroom clean.
Don't shout! If you need the bathroom, ask: May I go to the bathroom?
Now the sound 'wh'! It says /w/: what, when, where, whale, wheel, white.

items.a: Do it when you want to speak or answer.
Do it when the teacher talks.

activities.title: Memory Game
activities.prompt: Match the action with the rule.
pairs: May I go to the bathroom?

activities.title: Good or Bad in Class?
activities.prompt: Is this a good thing to do in class?

items.q: When the teacher talks, you should…
If you need the bathroom, say…
o: May I go to the bathroom?

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 10–12
